# MOUJA SURF SCHOOL

> Beachfront surf school and all-inclusive surf camp in Taghazout, Morocco. ISA-certified surf coaching for all levels, surf & yoga retreats, all-inclusive surf packages, beachfront accommodation, on-site restaurant and surf shop, plus day trips across the Taghazout region.

## Identity

MOUJA SURF SCHOOL is a surf school and surf camp in Taghazout, on Morocco's Atlantic coast. The visible brand is MOUJA TAGHAZOUT.

- Official website: https://moujasurfschool.com/
- Organization: https://moujasurfschool.com/#organization

## Location

- Taghazout, 80022, Agadir, Morocco
- Area served: Taghazout, Agadir

## Services

- [Surf Camp](https://moujasurfschool.com/surf-camp): The complete surf camp experience with ISA-certified coaching for all levels.
- [Surf & Yoga](https://moujasurfschool.com/surf-yoga): Daily surf sessions paired with morning vinyasa and restorative evening yin yoga.
- [Activities & Excursions](https://moujasurfschool.com/activities): Day trips to Imsouane, Paradise Valley and Tamri, with transport and lunch included.
- [Accommodation](https://moujasurfschool.com/accommodation): Beachfront shared rooms, private rooms and self-contained apartments.
- [Restaurant](https://moujasurfschool.com/restaurant): Authentic Moroccan tagines, fresh ocean fish BBQ and healthy surf bowls.
- [Surf Shop](https://moujasurfschool.com/surf-shop): Surfboard and wetsuit rentals, boards for sale and Moroccan apparel.
